pricing.intro: These are starting prices for our most common services. The final price depends on the granite, size, engraving, and site conditions. We confirm it after a short consultation.
pricing.bottomNote: Exact price is confirmed after dimensions, material, engraving, site access, and installation scope are clarified.
factorsBody: Final cost is shaped by granite color and thickness, monument size and shape complexity, the amount of engraving and whether a portrait is included.
It is also affected by site access, removal of an old monument, foundation condition and delivery to the cemetery.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We collect only the information required to reply to your request and prepare a proposal. Below is exactly what is stored, where it goes, how long we keep it, and how to reach us about your data.

cards.title: What we collect
cards.body: Callback form: name and phone number. Inquiry form: name, email, and message text. Both forms also record the chosen site language and the form type. We do not request other personal data.

cards.title: Where your data goes
cards.body: Form submissions are delivered to our team through Formspree (formspree.io), a third-party processor that forwards messages to us. Anonymous usage events (page views, form submissions) are stored in Google Firebase (Firestore) so we can improve the site. Traffic statistics are measured with Plausible Analytics, which is cookieless and collects no personal identifiers.

cards.title: Why we use it
cards.body: Solely to reply to your request, prepare a proposal, agree on installation, and improve the website. We do not run advertising profiles and do not sell data to third parties.

cards.title: Retention
cards.body: Form submissions and analytics events are kept for 12 months and then deleted, unless an active order or legal obligation requires longer storage.

cards.title: Your rights and contact
cards.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data, or withdraw consent, at any time by writing to ms.pamyatnik@mail.ru. We respond within 30 days.
